title: VIX futures and options October 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — settles inside the FOMC communications blackout, five sessions before a decision its own 30-day window contains
source: EST: THE PUBLISHER'S OWN CALENDAR AND THE VENUE'S OWN RULE, BOTH RE-FETCHED AND RE-DERIVED IN-SESSION 2026-09-06 BY THIS EVENT'S INITIAL RESEARCH -- nothing inherited from the proposal. THE RULE, APPLIED COLD: cboe.com/tradable_products/vix/vix_futures/specifications/ (HTTP 200, 461,261 bytes) states verbatim "The final settlement date for a contract with the \"VX\" ticker symbol is on the Wednesday that is 30 days prior to the third Friday of the calendar month immediately following the month in which the contract expires", with the holiday clause "If that Wednesday or the Friday that is 30 days following that Wednesday is a Cboe Options holiday, the final settlement date for the contract shall be on the business day immediately preceding that Wednesday." For the October 2027 contract (VX/V7): November 2027's third Friday is 2027-11-19, the Wednesday 30 days prior is 2027-10-20, and NEITHER LEG IS A HOLIDAY -- read off NYSE's own 2027 column this session (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, no 403 this run), whose ten 2027 closures are Jan 1, Jan 18, Feb 15, Mar 26, May 31, Jun 18, Jul 5, Sep 6, Nov 25 and Dec 24 -- none in October and none on 2027-11-19. So the clause does not fire and settlement stands on Wednesday 2027-10-20. THE PUBLISHER: the Options Industry Council's backing JSON at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), an artifact of The Options Clearing Corporation and the same source this repo's opex-2027-09-17 entry cites, carries a 2027-10-20 row whose GUID resolves in the document's own legend to "Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date". WHY THIS ENTRY STAYS ESTIMATE WHERE SIX SIBLINGS PROMOTED, and the reason is measured rather than asserted. (a) VX/V7 IS NOT LISTED: Cboe's settlement surface (www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04, HTTP 200, 1,731 bytes) stops at VX/K7 2027-05-18 and VXM/G7 2027-02-17; zero rows anywhere contain V7. Every OCC:-prefixed promotion in this class rested on the specific contract appearing on that surface. (b) THE ONE CALENDAR THAT DOES NAME THE DATE CARRIES A DEMONSTRATED ERROR ONE ROW LATER: this session cross-validated Cboe's rule against all 36 "Monthly Volatility Products Expiration" rows the OIC/OCC calendar publishes for 2025-01 through 2027-12 and got 35 of 36. The single disagreement is the publisher's own 2027-12-15, where the rule gives 2027-12-22 -- and 2027-12-15 is internally inconsistent with the rule the publisher's other 35 rows obey, since 2027-12-15 plus 30 days is 2028-01-14, the SECOND Friday of January 2028, not the third (2028-01-21). A publisher that is off by a week at the far end of its own series is not, alone, a confirming source for a date fourteen months out. The document also footnotes itself: "While these dates are accurate as of 1/2/2026, they are subject to change." PROMOTION TRIGGER: VX/V7 appearing on a Cboe settlement or expiration-calendar surface dated 2027-10-20. RECORDED BLOCKS, not worked around: cdn.cboe.com/resources/release_notes/2027_Expiration_Calendar.pdf HTTP 403 and theocc.com/company-information/schedules HTTP 403, both 2026-09-06, both in the ledger's probe-ref. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 initial research; canonical file written by this event's own initial research (docs/research/events/vix-expiration-2027-10-20.md), checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own initial research 2026-09-06 after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/vix-expiration-2027-10-20.from-fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16.json. THE PROPOSAL'S CENTRAL FRAMING IS CORRECTED, NOT INHERITED. It titled this event "the first tracked expiration to settle inside an FOMC blackout". That is false three ways, and the proposal itself asked for exactly this check ("treat the in-blackout settlement as a QUESTION to measure against the other tracked expirations, not as an edge it has inherited"). (1) IN THE CALENDAR: 6 of the 8 VIX expirations this repo tracks settle inside an FOMC communications blackout -- 2026-09-16, 2027-03-17 and 2027-09-15 ON the decision day (which is inside the window by construction), and 2027-01-20, 2027-04-21 and this one BEFORE it. Only 2027-02-17 and 2027-05-18 sit outside. Two earlier siblings already said so: vix-expiration-2027-01-20 downgraded the same observation ("5 of 9 listed settlements sit inside a tracked FOMC blackout; a majority property is not a distinguishing one") and vix-expiration-2027-04-21 already carries THIS EXACT GEOMETRY as its headline -- inside the blackout, five sessions before a decision its own 30-day strip contains -- and refuted an event premium in it on term-structure grounds. (2) IN HISTORY: applying the Fed's own blackout rule to 167 parsed FOMC meetings 2007-2027 and Cboe's settlement rule to 217 realized monthly settlements 2008-07 to 2026-08, 84 of 217 settlements (38.7%) fall inside a blackout window, of which 42 are the pre-decision configuration this event has. Robustness: reclassifying under the narrower pre-2011-style rule (Tuesday of the preceding week rather than the second Saturday) moves ZERO of 217 cases. (3) AND THE CONFIGURATION IS MEASURED INERT. Against 133 non-blackout settlements, the 42 pre-decision-in-blackout ones are null on all four measures -- VRO vs prior close P=0.86, VIX open vs prior close P=0.79, the SOQ's own basis to the same session's open P=0.61, close vs VRO P=0.70 -- and null again on the 35-case subsample that matches this event's exact five-sessions-ahead geometry (P >= 0.60 on all four). New to this class: the settlement's FORWARD accuracy is also identical. VRO minus realized SPX vol over the contract's own 30-day reference window runs +3.61 points on the blackout cases against +3.58 on the rest (P=0.99), and VRO overprices realized in 81% of blackout cases against 86% otherwise -- if anything slightly LESS often, the opposite sign to the extra-uncertainty story. What does move is the decision day itself, not the blackout: pre-decision settlements open +0.46% against decision-day settlements at -1.30% (P=0.042), corroborating vix-expiration-2027-09-15's pre-FOMC-drift finding from a different angle. STRUCTURE, carried forward not acted on: the 30-day reference window runs 2027-10-20 to 2027-11-19, 22 trading sessions with zero exchange closures (Thanksgiving 2027-11-25 falls after it), and contains fomc-2027-10-26/27 at +6/+7 with the decision unresolved for the whole stretch and the official interpretation channel closed until 2027-10-29. Impact low, matching every other vix-expiration entry. symbols is empty; trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for opex|expiration|witching|volatility settlement|SOQ and return ZERO hits in both, so no house playbook is calendar-, expiration- or settlement-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
